raw_text: Analysis of the latest round of Russian nuclear signaling suggests this is primarily information warfare rather than genuine escalation. Key indicators: no observable changes in nuclear force posture, no movement of tactical nuclear assets detected via satellite, and the rhetoric follows established patterns of coercive diplomacy timed to Western aid package decisions. The Bulletin maintains the Doomsday Clock at 90 seconds but notes the dangerous normalization of nuclear threats in Russian discourse.
clean_text: Arms Control Wonk assesses Russian nuclear signaling as information warfare. No observable changes in nuclear posture or tactical asset movement. Rhetoric timed to Western aid decisions.
